title: Keys
emptyDesc: No gateway keys have been issued yet
createDesc: The full key is shown only this once after creation — save it now
editDesc: Change the key's quota, expiry and restrictions
name: Name
daysRequired: Enter a number of days greater than 0
ipWhitelistHint: One per line; single IP (1.2.3.4) or CIDR (10.0.0.0/8); empty = unrestricted
upstreamHint: Once an upstream is selected, this key's requests only go to that upstream's account pool
upstreamsFailed: The upstream list failed to refresh; the bind-upstream dropdown may be missing options
modelWhitelistHint: Empty = allow all models; separate multiple with commas or new lines
modelPickUnavailable: Model list failed to load; you can type names manually
createdButRefreshFailed: Key created, but the list failed to refresh
createdButRefreshFailedHint: Refresh the page to see the new key; do not create it again
createdDesc: The full key is shown only this once — copy and store it now
resetUsageDesc: Reset the used tokens of “{name}” to zero; the quota limit stays unchanged.
deleteDesc: Delete “{name}”? Clients using this key stop working immediately, and this cannot be undone.
